_about: What the approver's page shows for a Project Completion Document (R&D G10 / AR G9). One file per form: change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the IRSProjectCompletion entry in js/config/TaskFields.js (DOCUMENT_TYPES). The route approves the Document itself (worklog 2026-11-03-04); the page reads it through our REST JAR, `GET resources/v1/irsproject/completions/{id}` (worklog 2026-11-03-08).
_generated: Written 2026-11-03 from the paper form R&D-COM-Rev.00 (As-Is Understanding/.../1.R&D/Forms/R&D-COM.pdf, read as an image), labels word for word, rows in the paper's order. Every value verified on COM-0000002 with the JPO twin `exec program IRSCompletionDocumentContext`.

_source.project: the project the Document hangs under (`to[Reference Document].from`): name, EPMProjectNo, category (its type), projectManager (its Project Owner member), customer, and the three dates
_source.task: the DOCUMENT's own values, under the keys CompletionDocumentService puts in `attributes`
_source.service: Key learning features: the project's own learnings, from ProjectContextService (learnings.created), as the PDF prints them
_source.none: not a value: the Project Manager / In-Charge/HOD / Divisional Head signatures live in the route, drawn by the approval panel below the form

_notShown: The top Date has no value while the route is running; kept hidden, as on the STM and publication forms. The paper's four paper counts are one table there; here they are four rows.
